scenarios.prompt: Dataset v3 has columns sample_id, temp_c and visit_day. Protocol P2 says each row is a sample; temp_c is a measured temperature in degrees Celsius and -99 means not collected. visit_day is an integer relative to enrollment day 0. Sample rows include temp_c values 0, 18.5 and -99. No participant linkage table is supplied.
